title: UI Redesign — Dashboard, Trends & Profile Page

details: Create `src/components/sleep/countdown-ring.tsx`. See handoff for spec. Verify: renders circle with correct SVG progress arc.
Create `src/components/sleep/subtitle-pills.tsx`. See handoff for spec. Verify: renders coloured pills with icons.
Create `src/components/sleep/action-buttons.tsx` with PrimaryActionButton (gradient) and SecondaryActionButton (ghost). See handoff for spec. Verify: gradient buttons with press feedback.
Create `src/components/sleep/state-hero.tsx`. Combines title + pills + countdown ring + expected label. Verify: renders hero with all sub-components.
Create `src/components/sleep/timeline-section.tsx`. Vertical descending timeline with add/edit callbacks. Verify: renders timeline items with coloured dots, edit hints on hover.
Create `src/components/sleep/event-sheet.tsx`. Bottom sheet with add/edit modes. Verify: opens form with event type pills, date/time pickers, context, notes.
Create `src/components/sleep/chat-drawer.tsx`. FAB + slide-up drawer wrapping existing chat UI. Verify: FAB visible, drawer opens smoothly, messages display correctly.
Create `src/components/sleep/sleep-dashboard.tsx`. Orchestrator that picks hero/buttons based on sleep state. See handoff for state mapping. Verify: renders correct UI for each of the 5 states.

Modify `src/components/chat-content.tsx`. Replace old layout with SleepDashboard + ChatDrawer. Keep all data hooks unchanged. See handoff for before/after layout. Verify: app loads, states switch, events log, chat works via FAB.

Create `src/components/sleep/trends-view.tsx` and update `src/app/sleep-trends/page.tsx`. Average day card, stats row, history rows, detail sheet. Verify: page renders with visual timeline, tapping day opens detail sheet.

Modify `src/components/settings-form.tsx`. Two visually separate cards: Profile (white) + Family (lavender). Remove sleep training method field entirely. Add baby avatar, family members list, invite flow with prominent code display, danger zone at bottom. Verify: no sleep training field, two distinct card styles, invite code generates and copies correctly.

description: Remove sleep_training_method from DB and types
details:
1. Alter `supabase-schema.sql`: remove `sleep_training_method` column from babies table
2. Update `src/types/database.ts`: remove `sleep_training_method` from Baby Row/Insert/Update types
3. Update `src/lib/services/babies.ts` if it references the field (check updateBaby function)
4. Update `src/lib/ai/tools/` if any tool references it (check getBabyProfile)
Verify: `npm run build` passes, profile page has no reference to sleep training.

Add utility classes for FAB, bottom sheet, subtitle pills (per colour), timeline, animations, profile fields, family card to `src/app/globals.css` using @layer components. Verify: new components render with correct styling.

description: Clean up unused components and verify build
details: Remove unused components: SleepEventButton (replaced by ActionButtons), SleepPlanCard content (if no longer used), TimelineRenderer (replaced by TimelineSection), ChatInput (replaced by ChatDrawer). Check references first. Run `npm run build` and `npm run lint` — fix any issues. Test with mock data. Manual spot-check: each sleep state, chat drawer, trends page, profile page.
